description: MECHANISM (mirror of `core-language/check/repcount-in-comprehension-outside-repeat`): a `map` body is TRANSPARENT to `repcount`, so the same body nested inside a `repeat` is clean and reads the ENCLOSING turn (issue #1155). The two `print` payloads are `[1]` then `[2]` — the map's single element is the outer `repeat`'s turn number, which is what proves transparency rather than mere silence: a rule that treated a comprehension body as a `repcount` boundary would make `check()` refuse this program, and the check-before-execution gate (`spec/execution-model.md:632`) would leave zero events instead of these five. `execute: true` deliberately, so `check()` and the evaluator are asserted to agree in the CLEAN direction; the fault direction is asserted by the check-side mirror.
